criteria.check: One requested PNG; no HTML, animation or unrelated deliverables.
Count actual visible equipment and people against the brief.
Trace every required visible route; record occluded segments separately.
Stairs reach open landings, supports contact and feet meet surfaces.
Reference-like manual graphite, depth and purposeful architectural detail.
Neutral gray ink and near-white paper, no unintended yellow or sepia.
Exact English wording and correct arrow targets, or no text if requested.
No dependency on a personal folder or private reference.
Decoded PNG, non-overwrite, clean owned intermediates, preserved inputs.
Chosen topology is realized in actual zones and routes, not evidence detached from rendered geometry.
Open repeated briefs vary allowed topology/program, not only seed texture, camera or scale; explicit repetition/seed overrides prevail.
A display section derives from a separately validated physical model; omitted walls never excuse solid-host access failure.
Report unsupported, not_run and occluded checks explicitly; do not turn a legacy result or graph test into full physical/artistic approval.

rule: Do not compute a pass from numerical geometry alone. Any required fail fails the artistic acceptance; not_run and occluded_unverified are not positive evidence.
